claim: Leave-one-CELL-out conformal calibration undercovers on a NEW condition when cells within a condition are correlated. The level alpha is exact at the unit it was calibrated on; the failure is the transfer to a new unit. This is an (A5) failure, not a defect of conformal prediction.
model: Delta_kj = mu_k + eps_kj; mu_k ~ N(0,tau^2), eps_kj ~ N(0,sigma^2)
estimator: predicts a cell by the mean of same-condition calibration cells; falls back to the global mean on an unseen condition (what a GBM on condition-identifying evidence features learns)

controls.tau_zero_is_the_control: at tau=0 cells are genuinely exchangeable and BOTH radii attain nominal coverage, so the witness isolates the dependence structure and nothing else
controls.in_pool_control: the cell-out radius attains nominal coverage (0.9005) for a new cell of a SEEN condition, so it is not simply too small

rng: numpy default_rng, seeds 0/1/2/7 as coded; deterministic
status: numerically verified; Lean formalization pending (mathlib build in progress)
